text:
alina: heads-up, aquila13b-int4 on dedicated-canary exhibited 2x OOM rate on long-dialogs after the packing tweak. attaching short traces.

raj: saw this too. failure pattern: cudaMalloc fails during KV prefetch when max_new_tokens>=400. mostly multi-turn where prompt+context > 3k tokens.

cory: did we change any defaults for that deployment? I remember microbatch and prefetch policy were adjusted last week.

alina: microbatch=2, prefetch=aggressive on that pool. route had no explicit max_new_tokens so it falls back to service default 512.

ops: deploy-bot: Canary deploy aquila13b-int4 v1.2.0-quant -> canary-pool-2 completed at 1709998905 :white_check_mark:.

cory: quick hypothesis: aggressive prefetch + larger default max_new_tokens causes bigger ephemeral allocations and increases KV churn -> fragmentation on int4. two-prong fix: reduce route default max_new_tokens to 256; switch prefetch to balanced.

alina: ran local repro with those tweaks: microbatch=1, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=balanced -> no OOM in 150 long-dialog sims. latency similar. quality unchanged (small eval run).

raj: for longer-term, thinking hybrid quant for last transformer block (fp16) to mitigate planning regressions seen in int4. memory penalty modest. can do bench.

ops: applying route override now: max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=balanced at 1709998950. will monitor metrics.

deploy-bot: Update applied to aquila13b-int4-canary at 1709998951 by ops.

alina: note to release docs: annotate canary route override so self-serve users aren't affected. also open a support ticket template.

raj: queuing hybrid bench. bench command: bench-run --model aquila13b --variant int4 --hybrid-layers tail:1 --evals /evals/aquila/long-dialogs --out /tmp/aquila-hybrid.json

cory: will watch pool-level KV eviction stats; if eviction candidates=0 keeps happening we need to tweak eviction thresholds and enable kv_trim during warmups.

ops: early telemetry: canary OOMs dropped to zero in the past 12 mins; p95 latency flat. leaving kv_trim disabled for now to avoid compaction overhead.

alina: thanks team. will post bench outputs in this thread when ready.
